body.statement: For \(K\geq3\), there is a relatively open class of strictly positive two-stage binary-action SMART laws \(P\) for which \(\Theta(P)\subsetneq\mathcal B_{\mathrm S}(P)\). At the displayed witness, \(L_{P^\star}(0)=L_{P^\star}(1)=0\), \(U_{P^\star}(0)=0.45\), and \(U_{P^\star}(1)=0.50\), while \(F_{q^\star}(0)=0.05\) and \(F_{q^\star}(1)=0.40\). Thus \(q^\star\) is strictly inside the coordinatewise envelope, but the propagated tree-capacity facet \(q(1)\leq0.20\) excludes it because \(q^\star(1)=0.35\). The positive terminal-cell margin, envelope margin \(0.05\), and violation margin \(0.15\), together with continuity of the finite programs, preserve the separation on a relative open neighborhood of \(P^\star\) in the randomization model.
body.justification: The explicit strict witness shows that the whole-law result contains identifying information invisible in every separate threshold interval.
body.gap: Shahn2026Oracle establishes attainable envelope functions but does not display the interior geometry, the excluding cross-threshold tree facet, or a positive open set with strict nonrectangularity.
body.consumer: Joint remission-threshold, quantile, and stochastic-dominance conclusions in SMART-BD can be certified without combining mutually incompatible pointwise bounds.
